criteria-objective.reason: REGRESSED 2026-08-27 BY AUTHORING WORK, not by discovering a defect in what was already attested. The 2026-08-22 attestation was evaluated against NINE criteria, all CMP-0011's. Run 2 added twenty-three more (ACC-0013..ACC-0035) across CMP-0012..CMP-0020, and none of them had been judged against this criterion. Attesting satisfied over an unexamined set is the small dishonesty section 1 of this stage document warns about, so the criterion goes not-satisfied until the review happens. ⚠️ TWO CRITERIA ARE DEFECTIVE AND ARE WHY THIS IS NOT A FORMALITY. ACC-0014 asks that every rendered count equal the number of entries rendered — but the project view shows TOTALS, not artifact entries, so there is nothing independent to count and the criterion compares a number with itself. ACC-0020 states a 300 ms p95 compile budget with no protocol: no pinned environment, no timing boundaries, no warm-up treatment, and no check that compilation actually occurred on each request — so a cache could satisfy it while measuring nothing. ⚠️ RETURNS TO SATISFIED when those two are amended and the full set of thirty-two is judged. The other twenty-one from run 2 are sufficiently objective as written. ⚠️ NOT A JUDGEMENT ON THE COMPONENTS. Every run-2 criterion is not-evaluated because nothing is built; that is correct and is not what this criterion asks. Stage 7 defines the tests, it does not claim anything passes them.
